comparison.objective: Tune a damper vs place a long board behind an existing leaning stack.
comparison.physical_skill: Fine key/collar manipulation and torque control vs one arm retaining a leaning stack while the other inserts a board through constrained space.
comparison.success_condition: Two repeatable safe stops with no drift vs all boards correctly ordered, supported, leaning and released without removing short boards.
comparison.reason: Bimanual stabilization is shared only at a generic level; insertion behind an unstable stack is a different tested ability. Missing rubric detail: no material novelty-relevant gap.
